rationale: Recorded the companion premise to the empty-configuration vote finding so the audit's premise set matches the source it relies on: the pre-vote handler carries the same conditional membership guard as the real vote, so an empty configuration is a free pass in both admission paths rather than only in requestVote. The new source range (raft.go 1778-1784) is the pre-vote counterpart of s-votegrant, and the knowledge entry states the shared shape with both paths cited. No execution is claimed: the observation is a source reading of the two handlers, and the empty-configuration state that reaches it is already executed by receipts 1fb8595f and 6421d229.

knowledge.statement: Both vote admission handlers skip their membership guard when the receiver's live configuration is empty: requestVote checks inConfiguration only when r.configurations.latest.Servers is non-empty, and requestPreVote repeats the same conditional check (and the same conditional hasVote check) before the leader and log up-to-dateness tests, so a node holding an empty configuration grants a pre-vote as well as a vote to a candidate the configuration recorded in its own log excludes.
knowledge.conditions: The receiver's in-memory latest configuration is empty while its log still records a committed configuration, as produced by a restart with Config.RestoreCommittedLogs whose snapshot and scan start sit above the configuration entry; the request carries an ID and an at-least-as-up-to-date last log entry; the receiver knows no leader and the request's term is not older than its current term.
